slides.text: Evora, Portugal. The Church of Saint Francis.
Inside is a small chapel. Over its door, carved in stone, a message.
'We bones that are here... are waiting for yours.'
Centuries ago, the city's cemeteries were overflowing. Franciscan friars dug up the dead.
Instead of hiding the bones away, they built them into the walls.
The friars wanted every visitor to stop and think about how short life is.
Nobody knows the names of the people in these walls.
